name: Adamclisi

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay and Sémillon fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Sauvignon Blanc sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Pinot Gris is at its warm limit. It can ripen too fast, giving heavy, soft wine that has lost its freshness.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it. Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Marl is a limy clay. It holds water and makes vines ripen later, which keeps acidity in the grapes.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
